summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 6 upside misses — MRNA +5%, BMY +5%, UNH +4%, UHS +4%, MRK +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (DELL -11%, CIEN -10%, P -9%, ORCL -9%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: DELL (-11.48%) — Barclays downgraded Dell, HPE and NetApp to Equal Weight, saying AI server revenue reflects memory pricing more than enterprise AI demand. That set off an AI-infrastructure selloff (HPE, Oracle, SMCI). Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: DELL is a large-cap (~$350B), AI-hardware name that no strategy lists. The move was also an analyst-downgrade gap that hit at the open, and a long-only bot has no way to short it.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst found for 2026-10-15; searches returned nothing dated that day. Likely a technical or sector-driven move in volatile biotech. The 226.45 close doesn't match the ~$50-80 range seen in 2026 coverage, so check the price data.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: MRNA is a mid-cap, highly volatile biotech, a category the strategies don't include. With no pre-market catalyst, a +5% move would also be easy for gap and volume filters to skip.
top_movers.suggestion: (no actionable change) First verify the 226.45 close against a second data source, since it looks inconsistent with recent prices. Only consider adding high-beta biotech to the momentum universe if data checks out and the risk caps allow it.

top_movers.catalyst: No confirmed Oct 15 driver found. BMY's Oct 12 Phase 3 wins (RYZ101, admilparant) and a pre-earnings run-up (Q3 report Oct 29) may be carrying momentum, or this is a pharma sector move.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: BMY is a large-cap pharma that no strategy lists. With no clear same-day catalyst, a news-reactive bot had no trigger, and a +4.7% move with no gap or volume signature may not have cleared momentum filters.
top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap healthcare names like BMY to the momentum universe, or let a dynamic-universe rule admit any S&P 500 name with a close-to-close move ≥ +4% on ≥1.5× average volume. Skip it if pharma is outside the bot's risk tolerance.

top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: UNH is a ~$350B mega-cap managed-care name that no strategy lists. The move was also a delayed post-earnings drift two days after the catalyst, so gap and news-reactive filters had no fresh trigger.

top_movers.suggestion: Add a theme-basket (AI optical: CIEN, LITE, COHR, GLW) to the mean-reversion universe, gated on basket-wide drawdown ≥8% in one session with RSI(2)<10. Otherwise treat this as a no-op, since the bot can't short.

top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap AI-infrastructure names (ORCL, CRWV, etc.) to a mean-reversion watchlist, entering only after a ≥8% single-day drop on ≥2× average volume and an RSI(2) floor. Do this only if shorting stays unavailable.
